## What lands

- **`web/src/lib/dossier-index.ts` (`sig.dossier-index/2` model)** — `groupIndex` (the K4 §5.1 tree: United States first with states/territories nested and subdivisions under them, other countries A–Z, the honest unkeyed demonstration tail; a below-threshold registry parent's page climbs the slug path to the nearest page ancestor — Norman hangs under Oklahoma through no-page Cleveland County); `sortIndex` + `facetIndex` (the GET routes' keys/dims); `azGroups` (every row under exactly one letter); `publicationRegime` (SIG-JUR-010 — derived from the row's COUNTRY code, conservative `UNKNOWN` when no adapter exists, D-K4-7 closed adapter set); `INDEX_FIELD_DEFINITIONS` (every K4 §5.2 row field carries a named definition); `indexFigureSpecs` (one registered figure per rendered numeral — records, located by_point/of, sources, open questions, both disagreement counts, children count/pages).
- **`DossierIndexRow.astro` + rewritten `dossier/index.astro`** — the grouped index with the field set, the unkeyed demonstration tail, and the unplaced sibling held out of jurisdiction groups/counts (a data-quality report, never a jurisdiction). The place form GETs `/search/?type=place` (C-24) with the documented first-letter A–Z fallback affordance.
- **New GET routes** — `/dossier/sort/<key>/` (5 keys), `/dossier/by/<dim>/<value>/` (level, single-source, evidence-type — only extant values mint pages), `/dossier/a-z/<letter>/` + the directory root; the A–Z item joins the Places nav; `map/?jurisdiction=<jkey>` link per keyed row.
- **`web/src/lib/dossier-grouped-fixture.ts`** — the committed keyed corpus (US/OK/Oklahoma County/OKC, Norman under a no-page Cleveland County, TX/Harris County, VI, CA/ON, FR adapter, DE conservative-withheld) exercising conservation (SIG-JUR-007), the D-K4-3 threshold basis, and the conservative regime; the FIG-01a index sprite consumed via a `sig.figure-index-sprite/1` fixture doc (`web/public/dossier/figures/index-sprite.svg`).
- **`data.ts`** — `DossierIndexRow` gains the keyed fields; fixtures mode serves `GROUPED_INDEX_FIXTURE.dossiers` + the flat v1 demos as unkeyed rows; `getIndexSprite()` (fixture doc / `web/figure_index_sprite.json` when an export emits one, absent → honest no-glyph).
- **Registry/style updates** — `page-types.ts` `/dossier/**` owner → P36.34 (T1, examples added); `epistemic.css` index/glyph styles; `print.astro` `PRINT_LEVELS` exported for the row's print-link rule; `root-absolute-paths-baseline.json` allow-lists the new files' root-absolute hrefs with reasons; `index.astro` reach list + `Citation.astro`/`sig-cite.ts`/`[...path].astro` — every jkey/URL literal renders inside `<code>` (K14 NEW-8's exempted identifier class).
